episode_row: scheduler could sleep past first pitch; restart past deadline skipped fallback post

commits.subject: fix: scheduler fallback when pick's game starts before next check
commits.body:
The scheduler would sleep past the picked player's game start when
should_lock returned False (0% gap) and the next cluster check was
hours later. Now detects this gap and wakes up at game_time - 15min
to force-post, matching the existing post-loop fallback behavior.

Also fixes missing double_down team/pitcher args in the post-loop
fallback's format_post call.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix: fallback posts immediately when past deadline but pre-game
commits.body:
If the scheduler restarts or runs a check after the fallback deadline
(game_time - 15min) has passed, it should post immediately rather than
skipping the fallback entirely. Previous code gated both the sleep AND
the post on now < deadline; now the sleep is conditional but the post
always fires when no earlier check exists.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
